summary.name: TBD (To Be Downloaded)
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source native macOS app that downloads YouTube video and audio to your Mac, built on yt-dlp.
use_cases: Download YouTube sound effects or music for video editing
Save YouTube videos to watch offline, such as on a plane
Pick a specific video or audio quality for a YouTube download
Download YouTube content without ads or a website intermediary
Queue several YouTube downloads from the menu bar
summary.what_it_does: The app takes a pasted YouTube link, lets you choose a format or quality, and saves the file directly to your Mac. It runs on your own machine and connects straight to YouTube, with no account and no intermediary server. It bundles yt-dlp and fetches FFmpeg once on first launch. It can also be driven from a phone on the same local network by scanning a QR code. The page describes it as written in Swift and sitting in the menu bar, and it checks for yt-dlp and engine updates in the background, which can be turned off.
notable: Open-source, with source code on GitHub
Built on yt-dlp and runs locally with no account or server
Phone can paste links over the local network via QR code
Signed and notarized by Apple; installable via Homebrew cask or DMG
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon; not on the Mac App Store
Currently supports YouTube only; other platforms are planned, not available
Downloads FFmpeg (around 56 MB) on first launch; the app is 39 MB
